title: Decide and document declared-test recognition for Windows Codex PowerShell 5.1 workers
outcome: The declared-test contract explicitly states the supported behavior for Windows Codex workers using powershell.exe, with source and product-envelope evidence before any recognizer expansion. Unsupported wrappers remain fail-closed.
acceptance: Record source-cited current wrapper recognition and a real product worker envelope when an authorized installed-build proof is available; distinguish missing observation from a failed test and from verification credit.
Document the PowerShell 5.1 limitation or implement a separately reviewed narrow route with positive and refusal tests, preserving exact declared-command and argument semantics.
